name: WATOGA 2 PERSON BARREL SAUNA
description: The Watoga 2-Person Barrel Sauna is an easy-to-assemble DIY outdoor sauna. Crafted with top-tier materials such as rustic cedar, rustic fir, or clear cedar, the Watoga is the perfect sauna for your outdoor paradise. This model also comes with a tempered glass door and a limited-lifetime warranty.
